messages:
maya: Quick sync — we need to decide bug vs enhancement split for the post-go-live backlog. I pulled the top 12 items reported in the board and grouped by signal (customer, telemetry, regression). Asking: agree on triage criteria + owners so we can lock a 2-week hotfix sprint and a following enhancement batch. Link: https://tiny.redwood/backlog#sheet :eyes:

ajay: +1. can we use simple severity + impact rules? otherwise we'll bike-shed forever.

courtney: Proposed quick criteria: 
````
P0 = production crash / data loss (ship immediate hotfix)
P1 = core workflow broken for >5% of users or critical customer blocking
P2 = degraded UX / performance but workaround exists
P3 = polish / feature request
````

courtney: Also suggest customer-reported + billing/consistency issues escalate one level.

ben: I'd add "regression" flag — any regression from last release automatically P1 unless obvious minor.

maya: Good call. I'll annotate the list with the proposed P0-P3 + regression flag. Can we assign owners? Suggest: top 6 bugs -> hotfix sprint owners: ajay, ben, sara. Others go to enhancement backlog owners: courtney, oliver.

sara: I'm fine to own the test matrix + rollout for hotfixes. Can we include a small rollback plan per fix?

ajay: I'll take two fixes (cleanup cache invalidation + user profile error). Need help from infra for a canary — @release-bot can we reserve a canary window Thursday AM?

release-bot: deploy-window booked: Thu 09:00-10:30 UTC for team 'product-hotfix'. Please annotate PRs with `hotfix/canary` label.

oliver: For enhancements, I'd like to split into "fast wins" (<=3 dev days) vs "research" (>3 dev days). Fast wins get queued next sprint; research gets a short spike.

courtney: Agree. Also propose acceptance criteria for each queued enhancement: "measurable metric" or specific UX example. Keeps scope small.

maya: Final: I'll update the sheet with: severity column (P0-P3), regression flag, owner, quick win vs research, and accept criteria. Hotfix sprint owners: ajay, ben, sara. Enhancement queue owners: courtney, oliver. Delivery milestones: hotfix sprint (2w) starting Monday; enhancement batch planned for the following sprint.

ben: I'll prep test cases and a rollout checklist today.

maya: Great — owners, please add a short plan to the backlog row by EOD. If anyone thinks a ticket should change severity call it out in-thread. :thumbsup:
